ModMetaData.name: Better Spells
ModMetaData.author: Riketta
ModMetaData.description:
Optional autocasting for click-and-forget abilities, and dismissable cooldown-ready letters.
Autocasting works like deathrest auto-wake: an extra toggle button next to the cast button. Spells are allowed per spell in mod settings (they start on when allowed); the button flips the live on/off state and stays visible in both states, shared by all pawns - with several pawns selected the buttons merge into one. While on, the spell is queued as a normal queued job the moment its cooldown finishes - sleep and your own orders are never interrupted. Only abilities that need no target can be autocast (self-buffs and auras like Neuroquake or Combat command); targeted spells, world-targeted spells, ritual speeches and confirmation-dialog casts are never autocast.
Cooldown-ready notifications arrive as dismissable letters (like raid, orbital trader or masterwork notifications) with a per-pawn breakdown - much harder to miss than the default message. One letter per ability; spells handled by autocasting never letter, and abilities with cooldowns under 12 hours (configurable) are skipped. Letter style is configurable up to raid-like red.
Nothing is hardcoded: eligibility is derived from ability defs, so DLC and modded abilities work automatically. Everything is off by default. Enable autocasting and/or letters in mod settings, then pick the spells (settings list or the in-game toggle buttons).
Source code & details: https://github.com/Riketta/BetterSpells
